reasons: Cited text supports the compliant status: § 28.1 selects New York law and § 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, matching the rule's preferred position.
No arbitration seat or competing foreign venue appears in the clause; the injunctive-relief carve-out and mutual executive escalation are standard and do not shift forum away from New York.
No redline or comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original.
